blurb: Discover a world where reality bends at Museum of Illusions Salt Lake City. With over 50 interactive exhibits, guests can challenge their perceptions and engage their sense of wonder. Experience gravity-defying installations, life-size kaleidoscopes, and mind-bending holograms that play tricks on your senses. This unique attraction is perfect for families, friends, and couples looking for a memorable outing. Located in The Gateway shopping and entertainment destination in downtown Salt Lake City.
